Whenever you visit a site from another site there is, by default, a "referrer" field that tells the new site where you came from. If you do not click on a link, the referrer field is not generated. For instance click on https://www.whatismyreferer.com/ and then copy/paste the url and go to it manually. (edit/note Your browser may cache this page after the first visit resulting in it showing the same referrer when manually entering the url. Hold alt while clicking refresh to force most modern browsers to grab a fresh copy of the site.) Another way to fix this problem, other than copy pasting links, is to search for a browser plugin that changes your referrer. They are available for every major browser.
